backtest_protocol.execution_model: Before: current accepted allocator with exp-032 laggard/revision and exp-001 peer_shock source_notional_scalars. After: same source selection with only volatility_relief added at 1.25x paper notional. PnL is recomputed from selected row pnl_pct_net and scaled notional.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared accepted-helper source-priority allocator overlay

hypothesis: allocation: selected volatility_relief rows in the accepted helper allocator should receive a small default-off paper notional scalar because exp-20260620-033 corrected the sleeve independence map and showed vol_relief has positive total PnL, broad sample, and low mean overlap, while exp-20260620-032 and exp-20260621-001 did not scale it.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping volatility_relief scalar, source rank, allocator top-N, hold days, cooldown, VIXY/SPY/QQQ relief thresholds, or leadership thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Closed forward allocator replacement-value rows tagged by volatility_relief source family, or a materially new out-of-sample source independence surface.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The current accepted allocator selected zero volatility_relief rows after higher-priority sources and same-ticker cooldown, so the proposed scalar had no after-arbitration exposure and could not change EV or PnL.

2_history_check.exp-20260611-005: Accepted source-priority allocator family; this run does not alter rank, source selection, daily top-1, hold, costs, or cooldown.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-032: Accepted 1.25x source-notional scalars for selected industry_laggard_repair and revision_surprise_low_extension rows.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-033: Corrected independence map: vol_relief had 51 harness trades, mean net return 1.653%, total PnL $3,371.70, mean abs correlation 0.053, and mean ticker-date overlap 0.0161.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-001: Accepted the same 1.25x scalar for selected rolling_peer_shock rows; this run keeps that before state fixed.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: experiment.py new warned on allocator near-neighbors. The override is the exp-20260620-033 corrected independence map identifying volatility_relief as a positive broad-sample source not included in the accepted laggard/revision/peer-shock scalar set.

pre_run_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: add source_notional_scalar=1.25 for selected volatility_relief allocator rows, while accepted laggard/revision/peer-shock scalars, source selection, rank, daily top-1, hold, costs, cooldown, core behavior, LLM/news, and live/default orders remain fixed.
pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Before is the current accepted allocator including exp-032 and exp-001 source scalars; after adds only volatility_relief 1.25x. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no window EV/PnL regression, affected volatility_relief sample spans all three windows with >=20 rows, survival/concentration/drawdown guards pass, and the after allocator still beats accepted comparators.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism is capital allocation to an already selected accepted allocator source, not rank or candidate selection. The corrected independence map shows volatility_relief has 51 trades, positive total PnL, and low mean overlap, but source-notional allocation is heavily explored and vol_relief has higher max correlation to turn-of-month.

execution_envelope.kill_switch_calibration_note: 15pct is about 1.5x the worst healthy-window giveback (about 10pct of peak equity in late_strong); calibrated on frozen windows, so the in-sample no-false-trigger check is partially circular and the binding validation is OOS plus genuine forward rows (exp-20260612-024)
execution_envelope.slippage_model: entry/exit 5bps plus ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT per quant/fill_model.py and quant/constants.py; conservative for 4k USD orders above the ADV floor

production_impact.parity_note: If accepted, historical replay and daily default-off snapshots use the same shared accepted-helper allocator source_notional_scalars. If rejected, no shared helper, run adapter, daily snapshot, live orders, or core behavior changes are retained.
